Subject: Post-call: Helio Therapeutics mutual action plan & acceptance criteria

Hi Mitchell / Priya —

Thanks for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan so we have a single source of truth:

Pain points noted:
- Model latency spikes on batch inference during EOD processing (40–60% over target)
- Difficulty maintaining cost predictability across peak experiments
- Compliance requirement to retain detailed audit logs for 12 months in-scope environments

Goals we aligned on:
1) Pilot Redwood Dedicated for a 90-day production check with SLA targets (p95 < 250ms for 512-token requests)
2) Verify cost below $0.10 per 1k tokens for typical workload after batching
3) Validate end-to-end audit logs and KMS integration for PII redaction pipeline

Proposed milestones (high level):
- M1 (by 2026-12-22): Pilot kickoff, infra proofs, model mapping
- M2 (by 2027-01-15): Performance tuning + acceptance tests
- M3 (by 2027-02-28): Business acceptance & pilot close with ROI summary

Owners (please confirm):
- Helio: Mitchell (technical), Priya (stakeholder sponsor), Thomas Roe (procurement)
- Redwood: Marissa (sales), Laura Bennett (legal/contracts), Ben Carter (solutions)

Open asks / decision steps:
- Procurement timeline and preferred contract terms (Thomas)
- Confirmation of datasets allowed in pilot (Mitchell)
- Security questionnaire kickoff (we can share SOC2/AICPA docs) — attachment

I attached a draft MPA (helios_mpa_draft.xlsx) and a link to the live doc: https://drive.company/helios/mpa-draft

If that looks right, please reply with any owner/timeline changes and we will update the plan. We'd like to lock M1 date by EOD Mon 12/14 if possible.

Thanks,
